title: fix(gateway): ACP bridge photos are missing from Control UI chat history
body:
> **AI-assisted: yes**
Additional instructions **MUST:** Keep **Allow edits from maintainers** enabled for this PR so maintainers can help update the branch when needed.
Closes #193659 ## What Problem This Solves - Fixes an issue where users who send a photo through the ACP bridge (for example a Rabbit R1 camera shot relayed by Rabbit Agent) see the assistant answer about the photo, but the Control UI chat history shows only the prompt text. The photo is missing from the original user turn and stays missing after reloading the conversation, while a JPEG uploaded from the Control UI into the same session displays correctly. - **Related:** #51324 introduced inbound-image persistence for `chat.send` and carried an ACP-bridge exclusion plus a test locking that omission in; this PR removes the exclusion. Issue carries `clawsweeper:queueable-fix`, `clawsweeper:fix-shape-clear` and `clawsweeper:source-repro`. ## Why This Change Was Made - **Intended outcome:** An ACP bridge photo is claimed by the same canonical user-turn media owner as a Control UI upload, so the stored turn keeps a `media://inbound/…` reference and the Control UI renders the photo inline in the original user message, including after a reload. - `prepareChatSendUserTurn()` short-circuited `persistInboundImagesForTranscript()` whenever `isAcpBridgeClient(client)` matched, so no inbound buffer was saved and the resolved user turn carried neither `media` nor `mediaImageLayout`. The image still reached the model because `replyOptionImages` is wired independently from `attachments.parsedImages` — which is exactly the reported "the assistant can read it, the transcript cannot show it" split. The bridge identity gates ACP-only `systemInputProvenance` fields; it does not own media persistence. - **Out of scope:** No change to how the bridge defers its commit to the agent runtime (`requiresRuntimeApprovedChatInput`), no new storage owner, no Control UI change, and no change to what the model receives. - **Highest-risk area:** Sending the same photo to the model twice on the first turn — the concern raised during the review of #51324. - **How is that risk mitigated?** The existing generic suppression is reused, not reimplemented: every persisted inline/offloaded fact is marked `hydrationSuppressed: true`, and `collectCurrentImageAttachments()` drops every suppressed `ctx.media` index, so the persisted path is never re-hydrated into the prompt. The model still receives the photo exactly once, from the inline prompt image. The retained end-to-end regression test asserts this explicitly (`lastDispatchImages` still holds exactly one entry). - **Owner decision — the recorded rationale, re-checked on this head:** The review asks for an owner decision because the exclusion was intentional and test-protected. Provenance from public history: - The gate came from a **contributor-authored** commit inside #51324 ([`6b709d734b`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/51324/commits/6b709d734b), "gate image persistence to webchat callers"), landed as `c9449d77b40a`. Its whole recorded rationale is one comment line added by that commit: `// Gated to non-ACP callers: ACP/IDE screenshots are transient and handled upstream.` Later refactors dropped that comment, so on main only the bare `|| isAcpBridgeClient(client)` survives (`src/gateway/server-methods/chat-send-user-turn.ts:180-185`) plus the test name this PR replaces. The Greptile **bot** summary restated the same premise ("ACP/IDE screenshot flows … handle persistence upstream", [comment](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/51324#issuecomment-4101468041)); none of the five human review comments there mention ACP. The maintainer-side concern was double-submission, and @obviyus solved it **generically** (`602c0d1e22`: dispatch drops the persisted `MediaPath`s on the current turn, the canonical turn is rewritten after dispatch). - **"handled upstream" is not implemented anywhere in the tree** (audit at `origin/main` `abed61f6400`): `git grep -l -E "saveMediaBuffer|media/store|persistInboundImages" -- src/acp extensions/acpx` → **0 matches**, and "screenshot" does not occur in `src/acp`, `extensions/acpx` or `docs/cli/acp.md`. The bridge only converts image blocks into Gateway attachments (`src/acp/event-mapper.ts:233`), which is what `docs/cli/acp.md:36` documents. There is no "upstream" ACP media owner to defer to. - **"transient" is not true either** — ACP photos are already persisted today, just not where the Control UI can render them: `recordUserPrompt()` clones every prompt content block, image `data` included, into the SQLite replay ledger (`src/acp/event-ledger.ts:21-24` → `createAcpPromptUpdates`, `src/acp/event-ledger.types.ts:48-53`; row bytes are budgeted in `src/acp/event-ledger-bytes.ts`). That ledger feeds ACP `loadSession` replay only. It is exactly the reporter's observation: `acp_replay_events` holds the image block with data while the transcript holds no media reference. So the bytes are already stored once; this PR adds the managed inbound buffer plus a claim-only fact (74 B, no base64 in the transcript) that the existing history/renderer path can resolve. - The bridge identity does not own media anywhere else either: `requiresRuntimeApprovedChatInput()` (`src/gateway/server-methods/chat-send-goal-admission.ts:36-40`) has exactly two consumers — the input-commit decision (`chat-send-input-dispatch.ts:294`) and goal admission (`chat-send-goal-admission.ts:128`). So the question reduces to: should the canonical Gateway durable-media owner cover ACP photos (this PR, +13/-16, reusing existing suppression), or should history rendering instead be taught to read the ACP replay ledger (a much larger change across history projection and the Control UI, and it would still leave non-ledger ACP sessions without media)? @obviyus @fuller-stack-dev — a yes/no here is the only thing this PR is waiting on; if the answer is "render from the ledger", I will close this and open that instead. ## User Impact - **Success criteria:** After a `chat.send` from an ACP bridge client that carries an image attachment, the inbound buffer is saved once under `inbound`, and the resolved user-turn message carries a claim-only `media://inbound/` fact (`kind: "image"`, no `path`, no `workspaceDir`, no base64 `data`) plus its `mediaImageLayout` inline slot, while the dispatched prompt image count stays at 1. - **What should reviewers focus on?** The single condition change in `src/gateway/server-methods/chat-send-user-turn.ts` (`prepareChatSendUserTurn`), and the one regression fixture `persists ACP bridge photos as durable user-turn media` in `src/gateway/server-methods/chat.directive-tags.test.ts`, which replaces `leaves ACP bridge user persistence to the agent runtime` — the test that asserted the omission. The whole change is +13/-16 lines across two files; no test-lines allocation is needed. ## Evidence - **Real environment tested:** Yes — the shipped ACP flow was run end to end twice on an identical harness: a real Gateway started from this branch's source in a temp state dir (real SQLite state, real transcript, real `saveMediaBuffer` writing into `/media/inbound`), the real ACP bridge as a **separate OS process** (`node --import ./scripts/tsx.mjs src/index.ts acp --url ws://127.0.0.1: --token `) driven by a real ACP client over ndjson JSON-RPC on stdio, and the real Control UI (built from this head, `build=2026.11.1-7a5e5a1b3478-…`) loaded in headless Chrome. Only the model provider is faked, at its HTTP boundary (a local server speaking the Anthropic Messages SSE contract that records every request body, so the number of images handed to the model is observed rather than inferred). No Rabbit R1 hardware was available; the gateway log confirms the shipped bridge identity connected: `[ws] client connected client=cli name=ACP mode=cli role=operator auth=token version=acp`. - **Exact steps or commands run after this patch:** ```bash export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$HOME/.config/nvm/versions/node/v26.12.1/bin:$PATH" pnpm install --prefer-offline # RED: revert only the source fix, keep both new regression tests git checkout origin/main -- src/gateway/server-methods/chat-send-user-turn.ts node scripts/run-vitest.mjs run src/gateway/server-methods/chat-send-user-turn.test.ts \ -t "persists an ACP bridge photo as a durable user-turn claim" # GREEN: restore the fix, run the full affected suites git checkout HEAD -- src/gateway/server-methods/chat-send-user-turn.ts node scripts/run-vitest.mjs run \ src/gateway/server-methods/chat-send-user-turn.test.ts \ src/gateway/server-methods/chat.directive-tags.test.ts \ src/gateway/server-methods/chat-send-attachments.owner.test.ts \ src/gateway/chat-attachments.test.ts \ src/acp/event-mapper.test.ts # Types + format + lint node scripts/run-tsgo.mts -b test/tsconfig/tsconfig.core.test.gateway-methods.json --builders 1 node scripts/check-line-cap-ratchet.mjs pnpm exec oxfmt --check src/gateway/server-methods/chat-send-user-turn.ts \ src/gateway/server-methods/chat-send-user-turn.test.ts \ src/gateway/server-methods/chat.directive-tags.test.ts pnpm exec oxlint src/gateway/server-methods/chat-send-user-turn.ts \ src/gateway/server-methods/chat-send-user-turn.test.ts \ src/gateway/server-methods/chat.directive-tags.test.ts ``` - **Real-runtime proof commands (shipped ACP flow, before/after on one harness):** ```bash export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$HOME/.config/nvm/versions/node/v26.12.1/bin:$PATH" # Control UI assets for the browser step (this PR does not touch ui/) node scripts/ui.js build # -> dist/control-ui, "✓ built in 51.61s" # AFTER: this PR's head node scripts/run-vitest.mjs run src/gateway/tmp-pr193703-acp-media.server.test.ts # gateway RPC proof node --import ./scripts/tsx.mjs tmp-pr193703-ui-proof.mts # browser proof # BEFORE: revert only the source fix, rerun the identical harnesses git checkout origin/main -- src/gateway/server-methods/chat-send-user-turn.ts node scripts/run-vitest.mjs run src/gateway/tmp-pr193703-acp-media.server.test.ts node --import ./scripts/tsx.mjs tmp-pr193703-ui-proof.mts git checkout HEAD -- src/gateway/server-methods/chat-send-user-turn.ts ``` Both harnesses drive `initialize` → `session/new` (`_meta.sessionKey`) → `session/prompt` with `[{ type: "text" }, { type: "image", data: , mimeType: "image/png" }]`, then read the session back through `chat.history`, through the Control UI's own image route `GET /__openclaw__/assistant-media` (meta → ticketed bytes), and through a cold Control UI load in headless Chrome. They are local proof scripts kept outside the PR diff; the committed regression test remains `persists ACP bridge photos as durable user-turn media`. - **Real-runtime proof result (identical harness, only the source fix differs):** | Observation | `origin/main` source (before) | this PR (after) | |---|---|---| | ACP `session/prompt` | `{"stopReason":"end_turn"}` | `{"stopReason":"end_turn"}` | | Images handed to the model (recorded provider bodies) | `[1]` | `[1]` — no duplicate | | `/media/inbound` on disk | `[]` | 1 file, sha256 `862ea60f…5978` == the sent photo | | `chat.history` user-turn `media` | absent | `media://inbound/0ae22fe5-….png`, `image/png`, `kind:"image"`, 74 B, 8×6 | | `chat.history` user-turn `mediaImageLayout` | absent | `{ slots: [{ kind: "inline", factIndex: 0 }] }` | | `GET …/assistant-media?meta=1` (Control UI image route) | nothing to resolve (no claim) | `200 {available:true,mimeType:"image/png",sizeBytes:74,mediaTicket:…}` | | ticketed bytes from that route | — | `200 image/png`, 74 B, sha256 identical to the sent photo | | Control UI in headless Chrome after the reload | prompt text only; the sole ``s are the app icon and community art — no `assistant-media` image | ``, `naturalWidth:8 naturalHeight:6 complete:true` | | harness verdict | fails on the durable-claim assertion (`claim?.url` is `undefined`) | all assertions pass | ```text # AFTER — this PR head 7a5e5a1b347 (gateway RPC harness) PROOF acp prompt stopReason: {"stopReason":"end_turn"} PROOF model input images per provider request: [{"model":"claude-opus-5","images":1}] PROOF durable user-turn media claim: {"url":"media://inbound/0ae22fe5-cfdb-4c45-abf3-8152039e1ea3.png", "contentType":"image/png","kind":"image","sizeBytes":74,"width":8,"height":6} PROOF durable user-turn image layout: {"slots":[{"kind":"inline","factIndex":0}]} PROOF managed media store inbound entries: ["0ae22fe5-cfdb-4c45-abf3-8152039e1ea3.png"] PROOF stored inbound bytes: {"size":74,"sha256":"862ea60fb6fbdf1adb1143d3396b6eeec47ccc1e917fbcbe9efeb5c45b525978"} PROOF assistant-media meta: {"status":200,"body":{"available":true,"mimeType":"image/png","sizeBytes":74, "mediaTicket":"v1.","mediaTicketExpiresAt":"2026-11-05T21:28:56.948Z"}} PROOF assistant-media bytes: {"status":200,"contentType":"image/png","size":74, "sha256":"862ea60fb6fbdf1adb1143d3396b6eeec47ccc1e917fbcbe9efeb5c45b525978"} PROOF sent photo: {"size":74,"sha256":"862ea60fb6fbdf1adb1143d3396b6eeec47ccc1e917fbcbe9efeb5c45b525978"} ✓ keeps an ACP bridge photo in reloaded chat history and sends it to the model once 76376ms # BEFORE — same harness, only src/gateway/server-methods/chat-send-user-turn.ts reverted to origin/main PROOF acp prompt stopReason: {"stopReason":"end_turn"} PROOF model input images per provider request: [{"model":"claude-opus-5","images":1}] PROOF chat.history user turn: {"role":"user","content":"[Working directory: ~/workspace]\n\nWhat is in this photo?", "__openclaw":{"transport":{"clients":[{"id":"cli","mode":"cli","displayName":"ACP"}]}, …}} # no media, no layout PROOF managed media store inbound entries: [] PROOF stored inbound bytes: none PROOF assistant-media meta: {"status":0,"body":{}} # no claim to resolve FAIL TypeError: .toMatch() expects to receive a string, but got undefined # expect(claim?.url) # BEFORE — headless Chrome on the same reverted source: the reported symptom PROOF rendered assistant-media images: null PROOF page dump: {"url":"http://127.0.0.1:/chat/main/pr193703-ui-proof","imgCount":2, "imgSrcs":["…/apple-touch-icon.png…","…/community-art/community-invite-light.webp…"], "bodyText":"… What is in this photo? … PR193703_ACP_PHOTO_SEEN …"} # model answered, photo absent # AFTER — headless Chrome on this PR head: the photo renders from the persisted claim [ws] client connected client=openclaw-control-ui mode=webchat auth=token build=2026.11.1-7a5e5a1b3478-… PROOF rendered assistant-media images: [{"src":"/__openclaw__/assistant-media?source=media%3A%2F%2Finbound%2F897d1dc9-….png&mediaTicket=&sessionKey=agent%3Amain%3Apr193703-ui-proof&messageId=453b2033-…&agentId=main&variant=thumbnail&width=480&v=4", "naturalWidth":8,"naturalHeight":6,"complete":true}] ``` - **Evidence after fix:** ```text # BEFORE — only src/gateway/server-methods/chat-send-user-turn.ts reverted to origin/main, # the regression test kept in place (end-to-end chat.send from the shipped bridge identity) FAIL |gateway-methods| src/gateway/server-methods/chat.directive-tags.test.ts > persists ACP bridge photos as durable user-turn media AssertionError: expected [] to have a length of 1 but got +0 Tests 1 failed | 133 skipped (134) # AFTER — with the fix, rebased on origin/main d999f7b1b67 Test Files 5 passed (5) Tests 214 passed (214) # 9 (acp/event-mapper) + 205 (4 gateway suites) node scripts/run-tsgo.mts -b test/tsconfig/tsconfig.core.test.gateway-methods.json --builders 1 -> exit 0 node scripts/check-line-cap-ratchet.mjs -> Line-cap ratchet OK: 2 changed files check-test-lines-ratchet.mts -> Test lines OK; slack 14 check-assertion-safety-ratchet.mts --base origin/main -> assertion SAFETY ratchet OK pnpm check:max-lines-ratchet -> max-lines ratchet OK pnpm exec oxfmt --check <3 files> -> All matched files use the correct format. pnpm exec oxlint <2 test files> -> exit 0 ``` - **Observed result after fix:** With the fix applied, an ACP bridge `chat.send` carrying an inline PNG saves exactly one inbound buffer and the resolved user turn carries `media: [{ url: "media://inbound/acp.png", contentType: "image/png", kind: "image", … }]` with `mediaImageLayout: { slots: [{ kind: "inline", factIndex: 0 }] }`; the serialized turn contains no `path`, no `workspaceDir` and no base64 payload, the visible text stays `"bridge image"`, and `lastDispatchImages` (the images handed to the model) still holds exactly one entry, asserted in the same regression test. Before the fix, `savedMediaCalls` was empty and the user turn had no `media` at all. `hydrationSuppressed: true` on the plugin-bound fact is what keeps that count at one; `collectCurrentImageAttachments()` drops every suppressed `ctx.media` index, and the existing `stages ordinary WebChat %s images exactly once` cases cover that shared suppression for inline, offloaded and pre-staged images. - **Before evidence (optional, visual changes encouraged):** | Case | `origin/main` @ `474592cc2b4` | head (this PR) | |---|---|---| | Inbound buffers saved for an ACP photo | `savedMediaCalls = []` | 1 save, `subdir: "inbound"`, `contentType: "image/png"` | | Durable user-turn media claim | none (`media` absent, no `mediaImageLayout`) | `media://inbound/acp.png`, slot `{ kind: "inline", factIndex: 0 }` | | Images handed to the model (`replyOptionImages`) | 1 (inline base64) | 1 (inline base64) — unchanged, no duplicate | | Control UI reload of that user turn | prompt text only, photo missing | photo resolvable from the managed claim | | Control UI in headless Chrome (real runtime harness) | no `assistant-media` ``; only the prompt text is in the reloaded turn | `` served from `media://inbound/897d1dc9-….png`, decoded at `naturalWidth:8 naturalHeight:6 complete:true` | Screenshots were captured locally for both runs (`control-ui-acp-photo-before-fix.png`, `control-ui-acp-photo-after-fix.png`); no public artifact host is available to link them, so the DOM facts above are quoted instead. - **Ownership provenance audit (commands re-run at `origin/main` `abed61f6400` and at this head):** ```bash git grep -l -E "saveMediaBuffer|media/store|persistInboundImages" abed61f6400 -- src/acp extensions/acpx # -> 0 matches (no ACP-side durable-media owner exists) git grep -in "screenshot" abed61f6400 -- src/acp extensions/acpx docs/cli/acp.md # -> 0 matches (the "ACP/IDE screenshot flows" in the recorded rationale have no counterpart here) git grep -l "saveMediaBuffer" abed61f6400 -- src extensions | grep -v test | wc -l # -> 29 files: channels, browser, cli/media-output, media/outbound-attachment, plugins runtime rg -n "requiresRuntimeApprovedChatInput\\(" -g '!*.test.ts' src # -> 3 hits: the definition plus chat-send-input-dispatch.ts:294 and chat-send-goal-admission.ts:128 gh api repos/openclaw/openclaw/commits/6b709d734b --jq '.files[] | select(.filename=="src/gateway/server-methods/chat.ts") | .patch' | rg "ACP" # -> + // Gated to non-ACP callers: ACP/IDE screenshots are transient and handled upstream. # (the only recorded rationale; the comment no longer exists on main) rg -n "recordUserPrompt|createAcpPromptUpdates" src/acp/event-ledger.ts src/acp/event-ledger.types.ts # -> event-ledger.ts:21 / event-ledger.types.ts:48 — ACP prompt blocks (image data included) # are already written durably to the SQLite replay ledger ``` The two other `persistInboundImagesForTranscript()` callers (`src/gateway/agent-turn/agent-run-user-turn.ts:279`, `src/gateway/server-node-events.ts:568`) are different entry points, which is why the runtime proof above observes **one** inbound file for an ACP photo rather than two. - **What was not tested:** The physical Rabbit R1 → Rabbit Agent → ACP bridge chain was not exercised (no hardware); the bridge is represented by its exact shipped client identity (`{ id: "cli", mode: "cli", displayName: "ACP", version: "acp" }`, the tuple matched by `isAcpBridgeClient`) and by the attachments path documented in `docs/cli/acp.md` ("images become Gateway attachments"); on the client side of the bridge the ACP protocol SDK client stands in for Rabbit Agent, while everything from the bridge's `chat.send` onwards (Gateway, media store, transcript, `chat.history`, the assistant-media route, Control UI rendering) is shipped code. Browser-level Control UI rendering of the reloaded turn **was** captured in headless Chrome (system Chrome, Control UI assets built from this head); the deep session route was reached by client-side navigation from `/chat`, because a cold `/chat/main/` document request is only served by a packaged runtime. Full CI lanes are pending on this PR: locally only the affected `gateway-methods` type shard and the five affected suites ran, because this host has glibc 2.31 while the pinned `tsrs` 0.18.0 native binary requires ≥ 2.32 — the shard ran with the also-installed `tsrs` 0.16.0 binary (same `7.1.0-dev.20260929` TypeScript) and the pinned binary was restored afterwards. CI lanes pending. - **Proof tier:** L3 - **Proof limitations:** No live Rabbit R1 / Rabbit Agent capture (no hardware): the ACP client side of the bridge is the protocol SDK client. The model provider is a local HTTP server at the provider boundary, which is also what makes the "exactly one image to the model" claim observable. The two real-runtime harnesses are local proof scripts, deliberately not part of this PR's diff; the committed coverage stays the single handler-level regression test plus the existing shared hydration-suppression cases. The unit-level `saveMediaBuffer` mock in the committed test is now backed by the real filesystem write observed in the runtime harness. - **Review state:** Awaiting CI + maintainer review
